title: Q3
description:
“First began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed to us by those who heard Him, God also bearing witness.”
Read: Deut 18:15–19, Deut 19:15
a) Deut 18 promises a Prophet like Moses: “Him you shall hear.” Deut 19:15 requires two or three witnesses. What do these two texts bring to the way Hebrews lists Speaker, witnesses, and God's own testimony (signs, wonders, miracles, gifts of the Holy Spirit)?
